data.name: Tower Grove
data.detailed_description:
About The Game

Tower Grove is a tactical tower defense game with auto-battler elements, where every wave begins with preparation, tower selection, and careful defensive planning.

Buy towers from the shop, place them on the battlefield, strengthen your castle defense, and adapt to each new enemy wave. Every tower has its own stats, cost, and role in battle, while smart placement can decide the outcome of the fight.

Build your defensive line with different tower types: from classic stone fortifications to mushroom towers, living tree towers, and magical crystal towers. Use limited space wisely and create the strongest defense before the next wave begins.

Enemies attack in waves, become more dangerous over time, and force you to adjust your strategy. Watch the upcoming wave, refresh the shop, and choose between buying new towers or improving your current setup.

Features

  • Tactical preparation before each wave

  • Tower shop with refreshable offers

  • Different tower types with unique visuals and stats

  • Limited placement grid where every cell matters

  • Fantasy enemy waves with different parameters

  • Castle defense as the main battle objective

  • Cozy dark fantasy atmosphere with a haunted forest, candles, magic, and medieval towers

Build. Defend. Survive.

Every round is a choice: which tower to buy, where to place it, and when to take a risk for a stronger build. Create your defense and survive every wave in Tower Grove.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I3, R3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 1060 or similar
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I7, R7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 3070
